newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils crude pipeline closed due to full storag.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils crude pipeline closed due to full storag.

text.p: The crude pipeline feeding the Baltic port of Ventspils was closed on Sunday morning as storage tanks were full to capacity, shipping sources said on Monday.
The pipeline, which carries Russian Urals crude, was closed at 0400 hours local time on Sunday and remained shut on Monday morning.
"The tanks are full and the line's been shut since yesterday morning," a source said.
The pipeline was expected to restart after the 83,000 tonne tanker the Umm Said, which was scheduled to berth early afternoon local time, had been loaded.
Deliveries of oil products to the port were not affected, the sources said.
The Black Sea oil ports of Novorossiisk, Odessa and Tuapse were reported to be operating normally on Monday.
